title: New Mexico Public Regulation Commission
text_excerpt: Skip To Main Content This website is AudioEye enabled and is being optimized for accessibility. To open the AudioEye Toolbar, press "shift + =". Some assistive technologies may require the use of a passthrough function before this keystroke. For more information, activate the button labeled "Explore your accessibility options". Home Dashboard Advanced Search Contact Us FAQ Help Center Login add File, track, and access cases anytime, anywhere lock_person Sign In Sign in to manage your cases, upload documents, and more. Sign In to your Account person_add Register Register for a new account to use our eFiling system. Create a New Account bar_chart Guest Dashboard Browse public cases and documents without creating an account. Continue as Guest All In One Place Everything You Need to Manage PRC Cases. Handle filings, track case activity, submit comments, and request public records without paperwork or in-person visits. Instant Access to Public Cases Browse Dockets to Access Cases, Documents, and Filings Instantly Need to find a docket? Just search and go. Whether you're tracking a case by number, looking up a party, or browsing by company, everything you need is right at your fingertips. Filter, sort, and dive into documents in seconds, no hassle, just results. Learn More arrow_outward Make Your Voice Heard Submit Comments on Active Proceedings Share your valuable input on ongoing active proceedings - simple, guided, and fully online. Submit public comments without registration or create an account to track your submissions and receive updates. Your voice matters in regulatory decisions. Learn More arrow_outward File Digitally Submit Complaints, Filings, and Motions Online Submit formal complaints, filings, tariffs, and motions with digital signatures - all through a secure, streamlined process. No paper, no delays. Track your submissions in real time and receive instant confirmation once filed. Learn More arrow_outward Public Records Request Public Records Through IPRA File and track public-record requests securely through the Inspection of Public Records Act (IPRA) process. Get digital access to records as they are released, with real-time status updates and notifications. Requests are acknowledged within 15 business days. Learn More arrow_outward Professional Access Manage Companies and File for Clients Easily manage your company info, file for clients, and track all submissions in one simple dashboard. Tier 2 access gives attorneys and company representatives full control - register companies, submit filings, and monitor every case from a centralized hub. Learn More arrow_outward Learn More Dive Deeper Into the System's Core Features. Discover cases, filings, and decisions. Filter by number, category, or keyword to find exactly what you need. Explore the complete user guide for step-by-step instructions and tips. Go to NMPRC User Guide arrow_outward Need Help ? prc.support@prc.nm.gov | +1-888-427-5772 © NMPRC 2026 | Powered by
